name: Tokelau
facts: Rotates yearly between the three atolls

flag.description: A dark blue field with a stylised yellow Tokelauan canoe in the lower half, sailing towards four white stars of the Southern Cross at the hoist.
flag.symbolism: The canoe (vaka) is Tokelau voyaging into the future, guided by the Southern Cross that islanders have long used for navigation.

hook: Tokelau is a golden canoe sailing across a dark blue night towards the four stars of the Southern Cross.
trivia: In 2012 Tokelau became one of the first places in the world to get essentially all its electricity from solar power.
Referendums on self-government in 2006 and 2007 both fell just short of the two-thirds majority required.
